Priya (People Ops): Heads up: were getting a few questions about year-end carryover when a global office has a half-day public holiday that falls adjacent to a planned PTO. Example: India office has a half-day on Dec 24, employee wants full day off Dec 23 and Dec 25. Do we treat the half-day as a holiday (so they only consume 1.5 PTO days) and can people request a carryover exception if that pushes them over cap?

Ethan J: Good question. Our holiday policy stores half-days for some regions. HR portal will apply the half-day automatically if location is set. But the carryover cap calc uses full-day equivalents; half-days are counted as 0.5 toward carryover usage.

Lena M: Manager perspective: if the half-day prevents someone from using enough days before year-end to avoid carryover, we sometimes grant a one-time exception if they provide a coverage plan. Weve been lenient for caregivers/medical.

Payroll Bot: payroll-bot: Note: All manual carryover adjustments must be submitted by Dec 31 23:59 UTC to be reflected in year-end reporting.

Priya (People Ops): Official steps were asking managers + employees to follow: 1) confirm location in HR portal, 2) file PTO as usual, 3) flag half-day overlaps in the ticket form, include coverage plan and reason, 4) people-ops triages by case (caregiver/medical get priority).

Sam K: Is there a standard documentation template for coverage plans? Would help speed approvals.

Priya (People Ops): Yes, use the Coverage Plan template under People Ops > Forms. Quick bullets: dates, who covers, impact to on-call, customer-facing tasks, fallback contact. If approved we annotate the carryover exception with the ticket ID.

Ethan J: Also note contractors and interns have different carryover rules (contractors must follow contract terms; interns typically forfeit unused PTO at term end).

Lena M: One more thing: remote employees who travel to a different country for work might be subject to the holiday schedule of their travel location for that workweek. Check with people-ops before booking extended travel over holidays.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks team. Ill post this as a short FAQ doc and a slack pinned message in the People Ops channel.
